propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval fails because make_observed_upsert filters for source=='tool' only, missing policy-generated fallback snapshots that fire on the 3-response boundary.

System-level boundedness holds (policy fallbacks bank at [2,5,8,...] within max_gap=3) but the eval's actor-filtered observer counts only model records, reporting first bank at response 6 and failing deterministically.
make_observed_upsert must record the first durable bank write of each criterion regardless of source (model or fallback), excluding only seeded=True cache seeds.

A fallback-only transcript (model never records; policy snapshots [2,5,8,11,14]) and the live run-32575679530 shape (fallbacks at 2/5 + genuine records at 6/7/8) must pass the bounded_bank_gaps oracle with max_gap=3.
A genuinely-unbounded transcript (fallback disabled, first bank after response 6) must fail the oracle in final form, confirming the gap-bound assertion has teeth.
